important_findings: The most reliable named classical source in this batch is Li Jie's Yingzao Fashi, but its authority is architectural/technical, not Feng Shui.
A Yuan anonymous domestic compendium preserves several material/defect motifs and is bibliographically earlier than later popular compilations; it must still be described as anonymous witness.
Duo Neng Bi Shi repeats some motifs but attribution to Liu Ji is disputed, so it cannot be promoted to named-master doctrine.
Modern Vietnamese standards provide explicit pathways for dangerous-structure assessment, RC maintenance/corrosion, termite treatment, and current steel design.
